about.intro: Building the industry we never saw.

story.body1: In 2017, Imani Joseph left a comfortable major-label job. She opened a small studio in the Mile-End with a fixed idea: give artists of colour what she'd never received — the time, the listening, the respect, and a plan.
story.body2: Eight years later, Musiqlt is an ecosystem: studio, mentorship, development programs, community nights. More than 120 artists have come through our doors.
